chunks: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Ishaq (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr Ahmad b. Dubays b. Abdullah al-Mufassir narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi al-Bahlul al-Marwazi narrated to us. He said: Al-Fadl b. Hurmuz Diyar al-Tabari narrated to us. He said: Abu Ali al-Hasan b. Shuja al-Balkhi narrated to us. He said: Sulayman b. al-Rabi narrated to us. He said: I heard Kadih b. Ahmad saying: I heard Muqatil b. Sulayman saying: I heard al-Dahhak say:

A man asked Ibn Abbas: What has Allah, blessed and exalted, concealed of Paradise, when He has already informed about its spouses, its servants, its good things, its drinks, and its fruits, and what Allah, blessed and exalted, mentioned of its affairs and revealed in His Book? So Ibn Abbas said: It is the Paradise of Eden. Allah created it on Friday, then He sealed it. No creature from the people of the heavens and the earth has seen it until its people enter it. He, the Mighty and Majestic, said to it three times: Speak. So it said: Tuba is for the believers. He, exalted is His Majesty, said: Tuba is for the believers, and Tuba is for you.

Muqatil said: al-Dahhak said: Ibn Abbas said: So the Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, said: [A believer is] only one who has six characteristics, then indeed he is among them: whoever speaks truthfully, fulfills his promise, fulfills his trust, is good to his parents, maintains his kinship ties, and seeks forgiveness from his sin - then he is a believer.

key_terms.أَمَانَة: Trust — faithfulness to what has been entrusted, a core moral obligation in Islam
key_terms.اسْتِغْفَار: Seeking forgiveness — repenting from sins, the sixth and final characteristic mentioned
key_terms.جَنَّةُ عَدْنٍ: Paradise of Eden — the highest, hidden level of Paradise that Allah created on Friday and sealed from all creation
key_terms.سِتُّ خِصَالٍ: Six characteristics — the defining traits of a true believer as enumerated by the Prophet
key_terms.صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ: Maintaining kinship ties — one of the six characteristics, referring to caring for blood relatives
key_terms.طُوبَى: Tuba — blessedness; also the name of a tree in Paradise, symbolizing the ultimate divine reward

ai.seo_question: What are the six characteristics of a true believer according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through a chain reaching Ibn Abbas, describes the hidden Paradise of Eden (Jannat Adn) that Allah created on Friday and sealed from all creatures until its inhabitants enter it. When commanded to speak three times, Paradise declared 'Tuba (blessedness) is for the believers,' and Allah affirmed this. The Prophet Muhammad then defined the characteristics of a true believer who will enter it: one who speaks truthfully, keeps promises, fulfills trusts, honors parents, maintains family ties, and repents from sins. The narration was transmitted in the scholarly assembly of Shaykh al-Saduq in 368 AH.
